notes.title: Bug Fixes ver.240918.0651
notes.content:
Thank you for playing SPEEDUS – SHEDDING SPEED CARD.
We have implemented the following updates in version.240918.0651
－－－－－－－－－－
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where descriptions were not displayed correctly in the deck editing screen.
Fixed a problem where card displays and descriptions would glitch when using the Chess skill.
Corrected the effect of the Chess skill "Promotion" on the QUEEN card:
Changed from: "8-9: Add 8 cards from the discard pile to the opponent's deck. No effect if discard pile is empty."
To: "8-9: Add 10 cards from the discard pile to the opponent's deck. No effect if discard pile is empty."
－－－－－－－－－－
Thank you for your continued support of SPEEDUS – SHEDDING SPEED CARD.

Let me know if you'd like any adjustments!
